items.title: Peter LaCaze Interview, 1972-01-27
items.q: He was playing like, you mentioned the name, Scott Joplin and things of that sort, yeah.

ctx.x: His band plays all the orchestrations, you know?
Yeah. I play the love band. Yeah. He plays all those, Scott Joplin. Yeah, you have the band parts too, eh? Yeah, right. Yeah. Scott Joplin. Scott Joplin, yeah, that was.
Did you ever play that kind of music?
